t: This is Dovehouse Street in Chelsea, a street running roughly north to south from Fulham Road down to King's Road. Along the way it meets Cale Street and Britten Street, among others. It sits in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Jane Williams-Wynne, born in 1949, lived here. She is described as the wife of David Douglas-Home, the fifteenth Earl of Home, which gives the street a link to the peerage.
